targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at as time, model, AVG(CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN (output_tokens::float / duration_ms * 1000) ELSE 0 END) as tokens_per_sec FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', created_at), model ORDER BY time
SELECT worker_id, AVG(duration_ms) as avg_duration FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY worker_id ORDER BY avg_duration DESC

SELECT created_at as time, LEFT(task_assigned, 30) as task_type, AVG(duration_ms) as avg_duration FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', created_at), task_type ORDER BY time

SELECT model, SUM(cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_ms), 0) * 1000 as cost_per_sec FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_per_sec DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT created_at as time, worker_id || ' × ' || model as label, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'success') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as success_rate FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time_bucket('10 minutes', created_at), worker_id, model HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY time

SELECT created_at as time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p50 FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', created_at) ORDER BY time

SELECT created_at as time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p95 FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', created_at) ORDER BY time

SELECT created_at as time, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) as p99 FROM workflow.worker_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'success' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', created_at) ORDER BY time
